title: seed-e2e
responsibility: Owns the seed-e2e build or maintenance script.

errors.name: E2E seed fixture or browser startup failure
errors.description: The script never catches a rejection or synchronous throw from its calls, which include e2eFixtures(), rm, mkdir, chromium.launch(), browserErrorCollector(), browser and page calls, writeFile, errors.finish(), and the ReportRepository constructor, begin and record. The try/finally around the browser work only closes the browser and finishes the error collector before the error escapes, so the run stops at the failing statement.
